text:
Beginning: Sophia, an aspiring musician, struggles with severe stage fright that prevents her from performing her music publicly.

Climax: After finding inspiration and courage through encounters with seasoned artists, Sophia faces her ultimate challenge at a major music festival, where she must perform in front of a large audience to overcome her fears.

Resolution: Sophia successfully delivers a resonant performance at the festival, conquering her stage fright and launching her rising career.

The transparent material commonly used to make windows is glass.
